paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan son of Rabbi Chaggai and Rabbi Azaryah, in Rabbi Yitzchak bar Marion’s name, in Rabbi Chanina’s name: Midrash Kohelet, on ‘For man also does not know his time.’ Bereshit Rabbah, section 42, does not mention bar Marion, only ‘in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name.’ Rabbi Zekharyah and Rabbi Azaryah, in Rabbi Yitzchak bar Marion’s name: Midrash Shmuel, chapter 22.
